paragraphs.text: The Erg Raiders of Rabiah are a lightly armored fighting force of warriors mounted on horses and wielding scimitars to battle. Their skills are extensive, and their appetite for battle just as vast.

An erg , from Arabic عرق , is a broad, flat area of desert covered with wind-swept sand with little or no vegetative cover. Their original creature type was " Raiders ", but this was later changed to "Human Warrior".
